name: Circle Splat Rendering
definition: A rendering technique where voxels are projected as 2D quads (splats) in screen space, using a fixed offset to determine the quad size based on the splat size parameter and grid scale.
summary: Circle Splat Rendering projects voxels as fixed-offset square quads to efficiently rasterize large datasets, distinguishing itself from other methods by using simple geometric primitives rather than complex shapes.
